pageTitle: Install Klacks: Office PC, Guided Installer or Docker Compose | Klacks
metaDescription: Install Klacks yourself: Windows package for your office PC, guided installer or Docker Compose, with public holidays and working-time rules. Open source.

hero.badge: Installation · No license fees & open source
hero.titleHtml: Run Klacks yourself — on your own infrastructure.
hero.subtitle: Two paths, one result: the guided installer, or the Docker Compose stack for your own setup. The country package ships with your country's public holidays, working-time rules and industry presets (surcharges where defined for the country) — no registration, no licence fees.

industry.title: Pick your industry — optional
industry.text: Your choice is written into the country profile as a preset and determines which industry blocks are active on first start. The package always contains every industry — you can activate more in the app at any time.

onPrem.title: Guided installer
onPrem.text: The guided path for your own server: an install script generates secrets and a self-signed certificate, pulls the latest released version and brings up the whole stack — on Linux or Windows.
requirements: Docker Desktop (Windows) or Docker Engine with the Compose plugin (Linux)
Outbound access to ghcr.io and github.com (images and updates)

steps.title: Download and extract
steps.text: Download the ZIP for your country and extract it on the target machine.

steps.title: Run the install script
steps.text: Run the bundled shell script on Linux, or the PowerShell script on Windows. It generates secrets and the certificate, applies the country profile and waits until the stack is healthy.

steps.title: Log in and change the password
steps.text: Log in from your browser and immediately change the initial password listed in the bundled README.

compose.title: Docker Compose
compose.text: The direct path for teams that manage their own container stacks: docker-compose.yml, nginx configuration, init scripts, the country profile and a prepared .env template with every variable — you keep full control.
requirements: Docker Engine with the Compose plugin (or Docker Desktop)
Outbound access to ghcr.io and github.com (images and updates)

steps.title: Download and extract
steps.text: Download the Compose ZIP for your country and extract it — the bundled README walks through every step.

steps.title: Set up .env
steps.text: Copy the .env.example template to .env and set the server name plus passwords/secrets. The path to the country profile is already prefilled.

steps.title: Start the stack
steps.text: Run “docker compose up -d”, log in from your browser and change the initial password immediately.

path.title: On your office PC (no Docker)
path.text: For businesses with a single office PC: an installer for Windows — no Docker and no server of your own. The database, Klacks and the update service run as Windows background services, updates arrive automatically, and your data stays on this PC.
requirements: Also runs on Windows 10 22H2 (64-bit). Microsoft no longer provides regular support for Windows 10; security updates are only available through the paid ESU program.
Klacks is used directly on this PC — access from other devices on the network is not provided yet
Internet connection on first start (AI models, about 700 MB) and for updates

steps.title: Download the installer
steps.text: Click “Download for Windows”. The file “Klacks-Setup-win-x64.exe” usually ends up in your “Downloads” folder.

steps.title: Double-click and choose your country
steps.text: Double-click the file. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click “More info” and then “Run anyway” — the installer is not digitally signed yet. Confirm the administrator prompt that follows with “Yes”. In the wizard, choose your country (public holidays, time zone, working-time rules) and, if you like, a desktop shortcut. The wizard shows its progress; the installation takes a few minutes.

steps.title: Open Klacks and sign in
steps.text: At the end, leave “Open Klacks in the browser” ticked and click “Finish”. Later you will find Klacks in the Start menu under “Klacks” (or at http://localhost:5180 in your browser). Sign in with the initial account the wizard shows at the end and create your own administrator account. If Klacks is still starting, wait a few minutes — the first start takes a little longer.

native.architectureNote: For 64-bit Windows (x64). On Windows 11 devices with an ARM processor (e.g. Snapdragon X) Klacks runs through emulation; Windows 10 on ARM is not supported.
native.linuxNote: Linux? See below: Klacks on a Linux PC.
native.uninstallNote: Uninstalling: Klacks can be removed like any other Windows program — open Settings › Apps, find the “Klacks” entry and choose “Uninstall”. The uninstaller asks whether the database, settings and backups should be deleted as well. If you answer “No”, your data stays in C:\ProgramData\Klacks and a later reinstallation picks it up again.
native.heroSubtitle: Three paths, one result: the Windows package for your office PC, the guided installer for your server, or the Docker Compose stack for your own setup — no registration, no licence fees. On the office PC you choose your country during installation; for the server and Docker Compose, the country package ships with your country's public holidays, working-time rules and industry presets (surcharges where defined for the country).

path.title: On a Linux PC
path.text: The simple way for a Linux PC, no prior knowledge needed: download the package, enter one command in the terminal once — the installer does the rest. Klacks then runs with Docker on this PC, updates arrive automatically, and your data stays on this PC.
requirements: 64-bit Linux with a desktop: Ubuntu, Debian or Fedora. Other distributions (e.g. Linux Mint) are not officially supported — there, please install Docker yourself first.
16 GB of memory recommended, because the browser and desktop run alongside. Below about 8 GB the installer stops.
Internet connection on first start and for updates
The administrator password (sudo password) of this PC

steps.title: Download the package and extract it into a permanent folder
steps.text: Download the ZIP file and extract it into a folder that stays where it is, e.g. a folder “klacks” in your home folder — not in the “Downloads” folder. The automatic updates work with this folder; if it is deleted, updates stop working.

steps.title: Open a terminal and enter the command
steps.text: In the folder with the extracted installation files, right-click and choose “Open in Terminal”, enter the command below and confirm with your password (it is not shown while you type). If Docker is missing, the installer offers to install it: answer “y” — this takes a few minutes. You only need the terminal this once for the installation; if you run the installer again later (e.g. for a repair), use this same command including sudo.

steps.title: Open in the browser and sign in
steps.text: Open https://localhost in your browser. The browser warns about the certificate — confirm the warning (“Advanced” and then “Proceed” or “Accept the risk”). Sign in with the initial account from the README in the folder and change the password immediately.

linux.certificateNote: About the certificate warning: during installation Klacks creates its own certificate, which your browser does not know — hence the warning. The connection is still encrypted.

profile.title: Profile only — for existing installations
profile.text: Already running Klacks? The profile (JSON) carries the country presets — public holidays, working-time rules, surcharges (where defined for the country) and industries — and is applied on an installation's first start. It is also the way to add another industry with its presets later.

fallback.noticeTitle: There is no preconfigured country package for this country yet.
fallback.noticeText: You can still install Klacks in full: the standard package contains everything except the country presets. You then set up public holidays, working-time rules and surcharges in the app.
fallback.composeNote: There is no separate Compose package for this country yet — the standard package contains the complete Docker Compose stack.

items.title: Open source (AGPL-3.0)
items.text: The complete source code is public on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 — no licence fees, no vendor lock-in.

items.title: Data stored on your servers
items.text: Klacks runs on your infrastructure. Staff and scheduling data are stored on your server — there is no forced cloud. Only if you choose an external AI provider are requests sent to it; with a local model, no AI request goes to an external provider.

items.title: Updates
items.text: An update service applies newly released versions automatically — with Docker as a service inside the stack, on the office PC as a Windows background service.

items.title: HTTPS with Docker
items.text: The installer generates a self-signed certificate to get you started — you can switch to your own certificate at any time. Change the initial password right after the first login. The Windows package for the office PC runs without a certificate at http://localhost:5180.

cta.title: Try first, install later?
cta.text: The Playground lets you test Klacks right in the browser with sample data — no installation, no registration. Or take a look at the source code on GitHub.
